title: WavePHP 2018 - Call for Speakers
content: The inaugural San Diego PHP Conference () is going to be happening September 19, 2018. We have opened our and look forward to having a tough time choosing between all of the proposals. Our goal is to have a well rounded conference that has something for the community as a whole. Please contribute a wide range or proposals. Our speaker package includes a ticket to the conference, round-trip airfare booked by us, 2 nights in the conference hotel. and make plans for a great time in San Diego, CA! WavePHPCall for SpeakersRegister today
